<p class="elv-tracking-normal elv-text-default elv-font-figtree elv-text-base elv-leading-base elv-font-normal" elv="true">Knowledge base software stores and organizes information about a business's products, services, and processes in a centralized, searchable repository, serving as a single source of truth accessible across the organization. These tools support a range of content types, from training documentation and project timelines to meeting notes, and offer powerful search and categorization capabilities to help employees find accurate information quickly.</p>
 


 <h3>Core Capabilities of Knowledge Base Software</h3>
 


 <p class="elv-tracking-normal elv-text-default elv-font-figtree elv-text-base elv-leading-base elv-font-normal" elv="true">To qualify for inclusion in the Knowledge Base category, a product must:</p>
 


 <ul>
  <li>Allow users to create editable articles, upload file types (audio, video, images, external links), or support both</li>
  <li>Provide cloud storage space for content</li>
  <li>Allow users to search for specific content</li>
  <li>Streamline content organization through tagging, taxonomy systems, folders, or AI-powered categorization</li>
 </ul>
 


 <h3>How Knowledge Base Software Differs from Other Tools</h3>
 


 <p class="elv-tracking-normal elv-text-default elv-font-figtree elv-text-base elv-leading-base elv-font-normal" elv="true">Knowledge base software is often compared to wiki tools, though the two differ in scope and governance. Wikis encompass a broader range of business topics and offer open, collaborative editing, while knowledge bases focus on products, services, and processes, with a smaller group of dedicated contributors managing content quality. Some knowledge bases are deployed specifically as <a class="a a--md" elv="true" href="https://www.g2.com/categories/contact-center-knowledge-base">contact center knowledge base software</a> to support customer service agents, and many integrate with <a class="a a--md" elv="true" href="https://www.g2.com/categories/enterprise-content-management-ecm">enterprise content management (ECM)</a> systems for cross-repository search. AI-powered knowledge bases further extend these capabilities by surfacing intelligent recommendations and embedding relevant content directly into team workflows.</p>
 


 <h3>Insights from G2 on Knowledge Base Software</h3>
 


 <p class="elv-tracking-normal elv-text-default elv-font-figtree elv-text-base elv-leading-base elv-font-normal" elv="true">Based on category trends on G2, ease of content organization and search accuracy stand out as the most critical factors in knowledge base adoption. These platforms deliver increasing value from AI-powered features that proactively surface relevant articles based on context and user intent, reducing time spent searching for information.</p>

<div id="my-expert-takeaway-on-knowledge-base-software" data-magellan-target="my-expert-takeaway-on-knowledge-base-software">
<h3><span>My Expert Takeaway on Knowledge Base Software</span></h3>
<p><span>Knowledge base software delivers the most value when organizations treat it as a structured knowledge system rather than a simple document repository. The strongest implementations organize information so teams can quickly retrieve answers, standardize processes, and reuse institutional knowledge across support, operations, and product workflows.</span></p>
<p><span>Review sentiment shows strong adoption. Across the 500-review dataset analyzed, the category averages 4.51/5 stars and 9.02/10 likelihood to recommend, alongside strong usability scores for Meets Requirements, Ease of Use, Ease of Setup, Ease of Admin, Ease of Doing Business With, and Quality of Support. These signals suggest buyers see clear operational value once knowledge bases are implemented effectively.</span></p>
<p><span>Friction usually appears when organizations treat knowledge bases as static document storage. High-performing teams approach knowledge base software with clear governance, defined content ownership, and consistent documentation practices. The best knowledge base platforms balance flexible documentation with strong structure and search, making them increasingly essential infrastructure for teams that rely on fast, reliable knowledge sharing.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="knowledge-base-software-faqs" data-magellan-target="knowledge-base-software-faqs">
<h3><span>Knowledge Base Software FAQs</span></h3>
<h4><strong>What is knowledge base software?</strong></h4>
<p><span>Knowledge base software is a system for creating, organizing, searching, and governing company knowledge in one place. Teams use it to publish SOPs, product information, onboarding materials, and common answers so employees or customers can self-serve faster.</span></p>
<h4><strong>What is the best knowledge base software?</strong></h4>
<p><span>The best knowledge base software depends on your team’s documentation needs, search capabilities, and governance requirements. On G2, top-rated tools include </span><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/slack/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Slack</a><span>, </span><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/notion/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Notion</a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/guru/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Guru</a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/clickup/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ClickUp</a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/confluence/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Confluence</a><strong>, </strong><span>and</span><strong> </strong><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/it-glue/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">IT Glue</a><span>, each earning strong user ratings around 4.6/5 stars and recognized for flexible documentation, integrations, and scalable knowledge management features.</span></p>
<h4><strong>How does knowledge base software help call centers?</strong></h4>
<p><span>Knowledge base software helps call centers reduce handle time by giving agents fast access to approved answers, scripts, and process steps. It improves consistency, speeds ramp time, and makes it easier to update frontline guidance when policies, products, or procedures change.</span></p>
<h4><strong>What are the leading knowledge base software for SaaS businesses?</strong></h4>
<p><span>Leading knowledge base software for SaaS businesses typically combines strong documentation features, search capabilities, and integrations with product and support tools. Based on G2 ratings and user reviews, popular options include </span><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/guru/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Guru</a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/it-glue/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">IT Glue</a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/bloomfire/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Bloomfire</a><strong>, </strong><span>and</span><strong> </strong><a href="https://www.g2.com/products/confluence/reviews" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Confluence</a><span>, which consistently receive high satisfaction scores and strong adoption among SaaS and IT teams.</span></p>

The amount of time it takes to train team members is far less than it would be one-on-one.  Be prepared for the largest amount of time taken in the initial formation of your Waybook.  Once it's formed, though, unless your business has any internal updates, it's ready for every future team member.  Done!

If you need help forming your Waybook, their staff is great!  They helped train me how to use the Waybook software itself, and I enlisted the service they offer of forming the Waybook for you.  Their response times to questions are very prompt - 1 day turnaround for UK to US.

What I really love are all the controls administrators and team members have.  You can section one training for one department, one for another, and they're not overwhelmed with things they don't need.  The best part is if a team member has any question, the Waybook is searchable!  Ask your Waybook a question, and as long as you've input your business processes, Waybook will answer them.

No more taking all day to answer questions.  It does it for you so you can concentrate on growth.</p></div><div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"><div class="flex-shrink-0 w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-error-80 flex items-center justify-center"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-minus h-3 w-3 text-error-80" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"></path></svg></div><span class="text-typo-10 font-semibold text-neutral-99">Cons</span></div><p class="text-typo-20 text-neutral-90 mt-2">This is a tough one ... Things like Bit.ai, GDOCS, Process.st and a few others. 

They were all great at individual things, but they never combined the flow and storage and flexibility of Waybook.

Waybook is easy to use, it's got a clean interface and it flows logically. It's flexible in the formats it allows you to use. Whenever I onboard new team members, they 'just get it' - which says it all! 

I also trust the team behind Waybook with the storage of crucial documents. I mean I've probably uploaded 5000 videos in my various SOPS, and it's never crashed or had an issue.

They have some very useful shortcuts that make it very easy to write and add new SOPS. They keep adding new features that are actually useful, while avoiding feature bloat, which I appreciate.</p></div><div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"><div class="flex-shrink-0 w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-error-80 flex items-center justify-center"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-minus h-3 w-3 text-error-80" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"></path></svg></div><span class="text-typo-10 font-semibold text-neutral-99">Cons</span></div><p class="text-typo-20 text-neutral-90 mt-2">This is a tough one as they really have ironed out any issues I reported! 

My only current issue is so minor it's not worth mentioning, but when you do SOPS you often need to link to various items and it would be great if you could put the link in your clipboard, hightlight the word you want to link on and press ctrl+V to have it auto set the link (rather than clicking on the add link, and then clicking in the box and then pasting the link). Or they could do it like Slack, with ctrl+ U, then ctrl+V to insert a link quickly! 

As I said...very very minor!</p></div></div><div class="mb-4"><div class="mb-2"><span class="text-typo-10 font-semibold text-neutral-99">Reasons for choosing <!-- -->Waybook</span></div><p class="text-typo-20 text-neutral-90">It allows us to store documents in various formats, configure permissions and is an easy to use interface.</p></div><div class="flex items-center gap-1 mb-4"><span class="text-typo-10 font-semibold text-neutral-99">Review source</span><span class="relative inline"><button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed normal-case bg-transparent hover:bg-neutral-10 active:bg-neutral-10 hover:text-primary-70 active:text-primary-95 disabled:text-neutral-30 disabled:bg-transparent text-base text-neutral-99 h-6 w-6 p-0" aria-label="Review source information"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-circle-question-mark h-4 w-4 text-neutral-60" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M9.09 9a3 3 0 0 1 5.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3"></path><path d="M12 17h.01"></path></svg></button><div style="margin-bottom:16px" class="absolute z-50 bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 overflow-visible rounded-xl bg-neutral-0 px-3 py-2 max-w-[300px] shadow-[0px_2px_8px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-95 pointer-events-none after:content-[''] after:absolute after:h-3 after:w-3 after:rotate-45 after:bg-neutral-0 after:top-full after:left-1/2 after:-translate-x-1/2 after:-mt-[6px] after:shadow-elevation-2 w-[300px] text-neutral-90">Non-incentivized review: any software user can leave a review for any product listed on our site.
